key_frames.description: Opening frame: a man stands on a small church stage, mic in hand, with a simple banner and folding chairs behind him.
He pauses for effect, smiling as a few people in the front row start grinning before the punchline.
He delivers the joke, and the room breaks into laughter while one usher covers a smile near the aisle.
Closing frame: the comic nods and points toward the congregation as the crowd keeps laughing.
